title: OpenAPI Specification 3.0.4 is not supported with Swagger
description:
> Moved from https://github.com/posit-dev/plumber2/issues/58


With plumber2 version 0.1.0, I am getting the following error page when the openapi field is set to "3.0.4" and the doc_type of my api object is set to "swagger":

> Unable to render this definition
> The provided definition does not specify a valid version field.
> 
> Please indicate a valid Swagger or OpenAPI version field. Supported version fields are swagger: "2.0" and those that match openapi: 3.x.y (for example, openapi: 3.1.0).

Versions 3.0.3 and 3.1.1 both work fine. As does 3.0.4 in plumber. Plumber2 also accepts 3.0.4 as long as I use the "rapidoc" doc_type.

Judging from the Error message, 3.0.4 should work, as it does match the 3.x.y format. 

Minimal example showcasing the issue:

```
plumber2::api() |> 
  plumber2::api_doc_setting("swagger") |>
  plumber2::api_doc_add(
    plumber2::openapi(
      openapi = "3.0.4",
      info = plumber2::openapi_info(
        title = "Broken API example",
        version = "0.0.1"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  plumber2::api_run()
```

title: Swagger Package Vulnerability CVE-2021-46708
description:
There is a vulnerability documented in [CVE-2021-46708](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-46708) regarding the swagger-ui-dist package which recommends it be upgraded to at least 4.1.3. The 3.52.5 version of swagger-ui-dist found in this package under inst/dist3 poses a security risk. 

We are looking to use swagger as a dependency of the plumber package to host our API. However, we need to find a way to circumvent this security issue. We have tried manually removing the dist3 folder and its contents, but this leads to the following error when trying to launch our web API app:

{"error":"500 - Internal server error","message":"Error in file(con, \"r\"): cannot open the connection\n"}

We also cannot simply change the version in package.json.

Is the vulnerable version of swagger-ui-dist necessary for the latest version of swagger (v5.17.14.1)? Moreover, is there a way to remove this package from swagger without impeding its functionality? 

Thanks!

title: Move `master` branch to `main`
description:
Cc @schloerke

The `master` branch of this repository will soon be renamed to `main`, as part of a coordinated change across several GitHub organizations (including, but not limited to: [tidyverse](https://github.com/tidyverse), [r-lib](https://github.com/r-lib), [tidymodels](https://github.com/tidymodels), and [sol-eng](https://github.com/sol-eng)). We anticipate this will happen by the end of September 2021.

That will be preceded by a release of the [usethis package](https://usethis.r-lib.org), which will gain some functionality around detecting and adapting to a renamed default branch. There will also be a blog post at the time of this `master` --> `main` change.

The purpose of this issue is to:

* Help us firm up the list of targetted repositories
* Make sure all maintainers are aware of what's coming
* Give us an issue to close when the job is done
* Give us a place to put advice for collaborators re: how to adapt

*message id: entire_lizard*

title: Enable the "Authorize" button in swagger to include a bearer token
description:
I'm trying to enable the "Try out" buttons in swagger, when the API requires a bearer token. This then brings up a popup that allows for a token to be added, that is then passed on to the "Try out" calls of all the endpoints.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2441145/99721912-7e186400-2a75-11eb-8952-94b253f3e0c8.png)

Where should I activate authorization in swagger for my plumber API?

title: How can I use swagger ui?
description:
Hi. Thank you for your great work!!

I am using R by calling like the following JAVA code.
Recently, swagger was also updated to 3.33.1 to use Plumber 1.0.0, but "{"error":["404-Resource Not Found"]}" occurs.
The server started up normally, but it seems that the UI file could not be found.

Please, Ask for help in this..

Thank U.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
        String mainCode = "setwd(\'" + targetRepoPath + "/\')" + "\n" +
                "options(plumber.legacyRedirects = FALSE)"+ "\n" +
                "library(plumber)" + "\n" +
                "library(swagger)" + "\n" +
                "convert_empty <- function(string) {\n" +
                "if (string == \"\") { \"-\" } else { string }\n" +
                "}\n" +
                "r <- pr(\'" + filename + "\')" + "\n" +
                "r$registerHooks(\n" +
                "list(\n" +
                "postroute = function(req, res) {\n" +
                "cat(\"[\")\n" +
                "cat(format(Sys.time(), \"%c\"))\n" +
                "cat(\"] \")\n" +
                "cat(paste(convert_empty(req$REMOTE_ADDR), convert_empty(req$HTTP_USER_AGENT), convert_empty(req$HTTP_HOST), convert_empty(req$REQUEST_METHOD), convert_empty(req$PATH_INFO), convert_empty(res$status), sep=\",\"))\n" +
                "cat(\"\\n\")\n" +
                "}))\n" +
                "r %>% pr_set_docs(\"swagger\")" + "\n" +
                "r %>% pr_run(port=" + port + ", host=\'0.0.0.0\')" + "\n\n";
